mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(d.actual_qty), 0) FROM mis_stock_in i JOIN mis_stock_in_detail d ON i.id = d.stock_in_id WHERE i.create_time >= #{start} AND i.create_time <= #{end} AND i.approve_status = '1' AND i.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0'

SELECT DATE(i.create_time) as date, COALESCE(SUM(d.actual_qty), 0) as inQty, 0 as outQty FROM mis_stock_in i JOIN mis_stock_in_detail d ON i.id = d.stock_in_id WHERE i.create_time >= #{start} AND i.create_time <= #{end} AND i.approve_status = '1' AND i.del_flag = '0' AND d.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY DATE(i.create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT i.id, i.stock_in_no as stockInNo, i.supplier_name as supplierName, i.stock_in_type as stockInType, i.create_time as createTime, i.total_amount as totalAmount FROM mis_stock_in i WHERE i.approve_status = '0' AND i.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY i.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
